description.value:
For days that appear bleak and nights that drown out light, you want a beacon of hope in your back pocket. The TAP-30 Raduga is one such blinding glow, as its signature ‘cackling’ is really the sound of its oversized rounds clicking into place in its helical mag. The Raduga is far from one of Techtronika’s most popular creations, as it’s cumbersome, costly, and difficult to control without cyberization. Yet, its cheerful laughs (gunshots) and sparkles of life (blood sprays) are worth all the trouble. Because when you get to its core, the Raduga just wants to make sure its owner sticks around for more fun.

Cost: 1,500eb (Very Expensive)

Class: EQ Heavy SMG • Skill: Handgun • Range: Subcompact SMG

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 20 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Pistol 5), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 1 • Attachments: SMG Cyclic Internals [Machine Pistol 4], SMG Short Barrel • Mods: Upsized Power

Special Features: This weapon cannot be silenced or suppressed in any way and requires BODY 10+ to wield unless Mounted [Upsized Power].

Range: Subcompact SMG
Pre-installed: SMG Cyclic Internals [Machine Pistol 4], SMG Short Barrel (effects already included in these stats)
Mods: Upsized Power
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 5), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
